methodology.description: Public draft-helper PPR redraft board. Player value and market cost are intentionally kept separate. Rankings blend broad expert consensus, current projections, recent independent expert boards and material preseason/news context; ADP is treated as price rather than player quality. League scoring, roster construction, draft slot, drafted players, positional scarcity and next-pick pressure are applied by the client recommendation engine.
rankingInputs: FantasyPros 2026 PPR expert consensus, ECR/ADP pages and late-August riser/faller coverage checked Aug. 27
ESPN Field Yates Top 160 plus Aug. 26 Fantasy Football Marathon 10-team PPR mock and Aug. 27 training-camp updates
CBS Sports consensus/mocks and SportsLine sleeper/breakout model updates through Aug. 27
RotoWire PPR cheat sheet, high-stakes ADP mock and preseason Week 2 analysis checked Aug. 27
NFL.com preseason Week 2/Week 3 coverage, roster-cut news, team-source and local beat reporting for injury/depth-chart developments
FantasyPros consensus projections and current aggregated PPR ADP
methodology.marketInput: Current FantasyPros aggregated PPR ADP remains the primary market-price input, cross-checked against CBS, ESPN and RotoWire. ADP is a price signal, not a substitute for player value. The Aug. 27 market still broadly supports the prior day's top-30 price map; no sufficiently large price move was found to justify a public-board value change on ADP alone.
newsInputs: Ashton Jeanty remains discounted but not buried. The latest independent coverage still describes the injury as an ankle sprain rather than a long-term or season-ending issue, and no new Aug. 27 report materially worsened the outlook. Week 1 uncertainty remains the reason his public-board value stays below market.

Kenneth Walker III remains at No. 20. RotoWire continues to project a larger Kansas City role, and no new Aug. 27 practice or team report surfaced that justified reversing the Aug. 26 upgrade. The prior foot scare remains a range-widening risk rather than a ranking collapse trigger.
Malik Nabers remains at No. 24. The recovery trend toward Week 1 remains positive, but there is still enough model disagreement to preserve a wide expert range rather than force another upgrade.

Christian McCaffrey remains at No. 9. No new Aug. 27 report materially changed the injury-risk assessment after his return to practice; the board continues to price in a modest durability discount relative to market.
No new suspension, trade, depth-chart demotion, preseason-usage shock or top-30 injury development found on Aug. 27 was strong enough to produce a meaningful player-value rank change.
methodology.notes: Expert disagreement is preserved with expertLow/expertHigh ranges; unresolved injuries and genuine model disagreement can intentionally widen those ranges. Confidence reflects agreement plus news certainty, not ceiling. The Aug. 27 refresh re-ran the public board against fresh FantasyPros, ESPN, CBS/SportsLine, RotoWire and NFL/team news. The prior Aug. 26 value corrections remain supported, and no new evidence met the threshold for another meaningful rank move. Market/ADP remains separate from player value. This file is used only by smhillis/sleeper-draft-helper-public and must not be copied into or used to modify Scott's personal Sleeper Draft Assistant.

players.name: James Cook III
players.news: Strong human-expert support remains in place and ESPN's Aug. 26 mock took him seventh overall, but SportsLine's current model is a meaningful bearish outlier and ranks him closer to a late-second/third-round RB value.

players.name: Christian McCaffrey
players.news: Returned to practice Aug. 23 after nearly three weeks sidelined by generalized tightness. Week 1 remains the target; injury risk is reduced, not erased.

players.name: Chris Olave
players.news: Jordyn Tyson's hamstring issue improves Olave's already strong target-volume outlook.

players.name: Rashee Rice
players.news: NFL closed its investigation with no additional discipline. Knee recovery remains the main risk, materially reducing the prior suspension discount.

players.name: Omarion Hampton
players.news: Upgraded after converging evidence: RotoWire PPR rank 14 on Aug. 26, ESPN expert mock pick 17, FantasyPros RB10 ECR and SportsLine breakout support. Current PPR ADP around 18 is now broadly aligned with the public-board value rather than materially ahead of it.

players.name: Kenneth Walker III
players.news: Moved sharply up from 27. FantasyPros has Walker RB9 by ECR, RotoWire ranks him 17th overall, and ESPN's Aug. 26 expert mock took him 11th. The earlier foot issue still widens the range, but no Aug. 27 evidence justified undoing the upgrade.

players.name: Ashton Jeanty
players.news: Remains discounted after the ankle sprain, but fresh Aug. 27 checks found no evidence of a long-term setback. Week 1 uncertainty still warrants a clear discount from market price.

players.name: Malik Nabers
players.news: Shed the red non-contact jersey Aug. 24 and is trending toward Week 1. ESPN's Aug. 26 expert mock selected him 22nd, while SportsLine remains materially bearish, so the public board stays near the middle with a wide downside range.
